profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Recursion
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Strong background with 7 years of experience in academic genomics and bioinformatics. 5 years of experience as a professional software engineer with a focus on building and scaling cloud data infrastructure. Currently working on transcriptomics data systems at Recursion. Leveraging my interdisciplinary background to build robust and efficient cloud data infrastructure in a rapidly growing company.
